comment: Close #4564: mux_daemon's mux-status-v1 handler now opportunistically refreshes a mapping's registry-tracked attached_clients (list-clients) at the same periodic cadence routed status renders already arrive at, instead of leaving it fixed at whatever (usually 0) a launch-time register() call supplied and never refreshed again. A probe failure (unknown count) is a deliberate no-op, never a reset to zero.
